items.description: Locate leak and open bathroom wall
items.rationale: The indoor supply pipe fracture is insured under §1.1, and §2.1 covers both locating the leak and opening the wall. Two hours at €95 gross per hour total €190.

items.description: Replace split 15 mm copper pipe section
items.rationale: Section 2.2 covers replacement of the fractured section, including the necessary fittings. Allow €145 gross for labour and €40 for pipe and fittings, consistent with the comparable repair in Case 21.

items.description: Close, re-plaster and re-tile wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 2.1 and 2.3 cover closing the opening and restoring the plaster and tiles to their previous condition, not retiling the undamaged bathroom. Allow €200 gross for labour and €35 for materials for the 0.2 m² patch.

Section 3.1 expressly excludes servicing and descaling even during the same visit, and the boiler work was unrelated to the leak. The €200 gross estimate is conditional only; the exclusion makes the payable amount zero.
